selection_method: Select conditional class-pair shifts on train-only OOF calibration; independent train-only OOF audit must pass all constraints, otherwise deploy identity. No use of held-out SCV development-validation labels for routing.
limitations: Some OOF 220-round models differ from the full 224/58-round frozen parents; model probability shift may cause training-only rules not to transfer. No official test accesses, no temporal claims.
reference: CARES-OOF-002-S42 six completed out-of-fold models; CTRL-TAB-001-S42 frozen standard and rare parents
